patterns.note: Sections are separated by extremely generous vertical spacing, creating an airy, almost sparse feel that emphasizes individual content blocks.
Dramatic typographic scale contrast, featuring massive, bold, wide sans-serif headings (often all caps) paired with significantly smaller, lighter-weight body text and labels.
A high-contrast dark mode aesthetic with a dominant black background and white text, accented by vibrant, glowing purples and blues from the abstract 3D visuals.

As the user scrolls, the hero text content scrolls up and out of view, while the background abstract 3D shapes parallax at a slower rate, creating a sense of depth. Subsequent content sections fade in and slide up from the bottom as they enter the viewport.
Each major content section is introduced by a large, centered headline, followed by visual examples or product cards, creating distinct visual statements.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed video or animated image of abstract 3D shapes as a background. Text content is layered over this, and as the user scrolls, the text scrolls away while the background image parallaxes to create depth.
A sticky header is implemented, initially transparent over the hero, then transitioning to a solid black background upon scroll to maintain readability and navigation.
Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation system, where elements fade in and subtly slide upwards as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, wide sans-serif headings (~8-10x body text) with small, light-weight sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant vertical spacing between sections and ample padding within content blocks, creating a spacious and minimal feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic use of full-bleed, abstract 3D visuals as a core design element, combined with an extreme typographic scale and a high-contrast dark aesthetic. It feels less like a traditional marketing site and more like an immersive showcase for the visual product itself.
